differences.resolution: All agree. POL-NS-01 holds on all four limbs, no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip, so compensation is paid and POL-NS-07 states the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, not NO_ACTION. The support refund of 2026-09-08 (EV-TRIP-04057 fee_refunded; EV-FARE-04057 REFUNDED 4.00) does not change this: POL-GEN-03's party-relative NO_ACTION applies only where the filing party's claim is not supported, and here the driver's claim is supported.
All agree. On DRIVER_COMPENSATION amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd (POL-GEN-03). Not the contested 4.00: POL-NS-07 pays 80 percent of the net fee.

All agree. Fee in force read from EV-TRIP-04057 platform_policy (resolution_rule): cancellation_fee_sgd 4.00 net, rider_gross null. Decimal: 0.8 x 4.00 = 3.20, already a multiple of 0.05 (POL-NS-07 itself quotes 3.20 of 4.00).

All agree. POL-NS-05 not engaged (fix at the 07:17:00 marker is 8.6 m from the pin at 0 km/h; position-derived speed into it 7.9 km/h), so no false-arrival record; the reason code is RIDER_NO_SHOW, so POL-NS-01's mis-selected-code referral does not arise; no other referral-producing clause applies in this category.

Key right; reader additions are harmless extras and no reason to change the key. POL-NS-01 establishes the fee and licenses DRIVER_COMPENSATION; POL-NS-07 fixes the payout and licenses DRIVER_COMPENSATION. Both apply. POL-NS-02 is the arrival test POL-NS-01(b) incorporates; it is satisfied but licenses only FULL_REFUND/NO_ACTION and fixes no amount here. POL-NS-11 licenses nothing and is not needed: POL-NS-04 already fails on limb (a) (no RIDER message) and limb (b) (two driver in-app calls), so the undecidable limb (c) never matters. POL-GEN-03 is the universal vocabulary clause the brief says not to lean on. No clause in the key fails to apply.

All agree. No party's story is contradicted by the record: the driver's 7-minute wait (marker to cancellation 420 s) and two unanswered calls are what EV-TRIP-04057 and EV-GPS-04057 show, and the rider admits oversleeping. Not ESCALATE, so not INDETERMINATE.

Every number, evidence id and clause id in the key rationale checked against the case file with Python (haversine R = 6371.0088 km): free_wait_sec 240 and cancellation_fee_sgd 4.00 (RECORD-PLATFORM); arrival 07:17:00; first qualifying in-radius fix 07:16:50 at 24.0 m (accuracy 5.4 m, 9 km/h), the 07:16:40 fix being outside at 59.8 m; marker-to-cancellation fixes 43, all 5.8-12.0 m from the pin at 0 km/h; accuracy over 07:16:50-07:24:00 at most 8.8 m (under 9 m); continuous 10 s cadence 07:16:50-07:24:00 = 430 s vs 240 s; RIDER_NO_SHOW, no boarding; calls 07:19:30 and 07:22:10 unanswered; rider_track 4 fixes all filtered at 35.4-44.8 m accuracy; no RIDER message in EV-CHAT-04057; no_show_terminations_30d 1, completed_trips_30d 168 (1/168 = 0.006); 0.80 x 4.00 = 3.20; all deciding artifacts weight 1.0. Rationale 1313 characters, ASCII. Stylistic only, no change: 'the marker fix was at the pin' means inside the radius at 8.6 m; the rider is called 'she' though the record states no gender.

analysis: Both blind readings match the key on ruling, amount, compensation, referrals and difficulty; they differ only by listing extra governing clauses. Worked independently on the version-6 text (three base files plus POL-NS-11, POL-RD-14, POL-NS-12). Scope: NO_SHOW_CHARGE, no safety or complaint flag, no damage allegation, so POL-GEN-08(1) permits an automated ruling. Figures in force (fee_schedule.resolution_rule): EV-TRIP-04057 platform_policy free_wait_sec 240, no_show_threshold_sec null, cancellation_fee_sgd 4.00 net, rider_gross null, arrival_marker BUTTON; zone STANDARD so arrival radius 50 m, rider presence radius 100 m, accuracy filter 25 m. POL-NS-02: fixes from 07:16:50 (24.0 m) through 07:24:10 lie within 50 m with accuracy at most 8.8 m - far more than 3 consecutive qualifying fixes, arrival established. POL-NS-01: (a) driver_arrived 07:17:00; (b) in the geofence at 07:16:50 and 07:17:00, at or before the event; (c) dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix 07:16:50 to cancellation 07:24:00 = 430 s, continuous at 10 s, against 240 s (420 s if counted from the first stationary fix, immaterial); (d) CANCELLED_BY_DRIVER with RIDER_NO_SHOW at 07:24:00, started_at null, after the dwell elapsed at 07:20:50. Displacing clauses: POL-NS-03 not engaged (stationary inside the radius); POL-NS-04 fails on (a) no RIDER message and (b) two DRIVER in-app calls, and (c) is undecidable because all four rider fixes are filtered (35.4-44.8 m accuracy), which under POL-NS-11 neither helps the rider nor impairs the driver's trace; POL-NS-05 not engaged (8.6 m, 0 km/h at the marker); POL-NS-06 not engaged (430 s >= 240 s; the MISSING advisory EV-ADVIS-04057-01 is relied on by nobody and limb (i) is not needed); POL-NS-10 not engaged (driver termination; the support refund is not a rider cancellation); POL-NS-12 not applicable (BUTTON). POL-NS-08: arrival and cancellation coincide with fixes (0 s skew), no gap over 120 s, 43 fixes in the window, chat ids 001-005 sequential and count 5 = chat_message_count 5, interval spanning the marker 220 s, fare line 4.00 = net 4.00 - no limb engaged. POL-NS-09: confidence capped at 1.0 (all deciding artifacts weight 1.0), no contradiction, counterparty disputes 0 + 0, driver no_show_terminations_30d 1 (< 4) and rider no_show_disputes_30d 0 (< 3), no impairment - no trigger. POL-GEN-01: prior_no_show_flags, ratings and the like are context only and nobody relies on them. POL-NS-07: anti-farming needs both 4 or more and a rate above 0.08; 1 and 0.006 trip neither, so compensation = 0.80 x 4.00 = 3.20 (Decimal), emitted as DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd = driver_compensation_sgd = 3.20 (POL-GEN-03). POL-GEN-05: 3.20 <= 8.00 execution threshold. Alternatives considered and rejected on the text: NO_ACTION because support already refunded the rider (POL-NS-07 expressly says that reading is wrong where compensation is paid); 4.00 to the driver (POL-NS-07 retains 20 percent); ESCALATE over the filtered rider_track (POL-NS-11 removes that route, and POL-NS-04 fails on limbs (a) and (b) anyway). The case file supports exactly one defensible answer, which is the key's. Verdict AGREE.
